senses.en: to make someone feel strong sadness, pity, or sympathy
senses.pattern: be deeply affected by / be visibly affected / affect sb deeply
senses.example: The whole class was deeply [[affected]] by the documentary about children growing up in a war zone.
senses.example_zh: 全班都被那部描寫孩童在戰區長大的紀錄片深深感動。
senses.note: 常用被動；affecting (adj.) 感人的

senses.en: to pretend to feel or have something
senses.pattern: affect indifference / affect surprise / affect an accent / affect an air of
senses.example: Leo [[affected]] an air of boredom, but his shaking hands showed how nervous he really was.
senses.example_zh: 里歐假裝一副很無聊的樣子，但他顫抖的雙手洩露了他其實有多緊張。
senses.note: 正式用語；affected (adj.) 做作的

senses.en: to speak to someone to ask for something
senses.pattern: approach sb about sth / approach sb for help / approach a bank for a loan
senses.example: Several students [[approached]] the principal about starting a recycling club on campus.
senses.example_zh: 幾位學生找校長商量在校園成立資源回收社的事。

senses.en: to begin dealing with a task in a particular way
senses.pattern: approach a problem / approach a task / approach the issue differently
senses.example: A good scientist [[approaches]] every problem with patience and an open mind.
senses.example_zh: 優秀的科學家會以耐心和開放的心態著手處理每一個問題。

senses.en: very much; to a great degree
senses.pattern: badly need / badly want / be badly in need of
senses.example: After three months without rain, the farmers [[badly]] need water for their rice fields.
senses.example_zh: 三個月沒下雨，農民迫切地需要水來灌溉稻田。
senses.note: 此義多與 need、want 連用

senses.en: seriously or severely
senses.pattern: badly injured / badly damaged / badly hurt / badly affected
senses.example: The old bridge was so [[badly]] damaged by the flood that it had to be closed.
senses.example_zh: 那座老橋被洪水嚴重地損壞，不得不封閉。

gsat.sentence: Becky twisted her ankle while she was playing tennis last week. Now it still hurts [[badly]].
[[Badly]] injured in the car accident, Jason could scarcely move his legs and was sent to the hospital right away.

senses.en: a written proposal for a new law
senses.pattern: pass a bill / propose a bill / vote on a bill / a bill on education
senses.example: After a long debate, the parliament finally passed a [[bill]] banning plastic straws in restaurants.
senses.example_zh: 經過漫長的辯論，國會終於通過一項禁止餐廳使用塑膠吸管的法案。
senses.note: 另可指「鈔票」或「鳥喙」

senses.en: to advertise or describe someone or something as
senses.pattern: be billed as / bill itself as / bill sb as
senses.example: The concert was [[billed]] as the biggest music event of the summer, but few people came.
senses.example_zh: 那場演唱會被宣傳為今夏最盛大的音樂活動，結果卻沒什麼人來。
senses.note: 常用 bill A as B

gsat.sentence: Founded in 1992, with some 28,000 listings, this company [[bills]] itself as the world’s largest home exchange club, reporting that membership has increased 30% this year.

senses.en: a short sudden period of activity or emotion
senses.pattern: a burst of laughter / a burst of energy / a burst of applause / in short bursts
senses.example: With a sudden [[burst]] of speed, the runner passed two rivals just before the finish line.
senses.example_zh: 那名跑者突然一陣加速，在終點線前超越了兩名對手。

senses.en: to be very full of something
senses.pattern: be bursting with / burst with pride / be bursting with energy / be bursting with ideas
senses.example: On the first day of camp, the children were [[bursting]] with excitement and questions.
senses.example_zh: 營隊第一天，孩子們心中充滿了興奮與疑問。
senses.note: 多用進行式 be bursting with

gsat.sentence: By exhaling air from the lungs in short [[bursts]] of laughter, breathing is quickened and heartbeats increased, which achieves as much good as ten minutes on an exercise bike.
And those small amounts of activity add up—30 minutes of light activity in two or three-minute [[bursts]] can be just as effective as a half-hour block of exercise.

senses.en: a grain plant such as wheat, rice, or corn
senses.pattern: cereal crops / cereal production / cereal grains
senses.example: Wheat is one of the oldest [[cereals]], first grown by farmers in the Middle East about ten thousand years ago.
senses.example_zh: 小麥是最古老的穀類作物之一，大約一萬年前由中東的農民最早開始種植。

senses.en: the general attitude or situation at a particular time
senses.pattern: the political climate / the economic climate / a climate of fear / in the current climate
senses.example: In the current economic [[climate]], many young graduates find it hard to get a full-time job.
senses.example_zh: 在目前的經濟形勢下，許多年輕畢業生很難找到全職工作。

gsat.sentence: Marian Anderson (1897-1993) was an African American woman who gained fame as a concert singer in this [[climate]] of racism.

senses.en: a group of buildings designed for a particular purpose
senses.pattern: a sports complex / a shopping complex / an apartment complex
senses.example: The city plans to build a sports [[complex]] with a swimming pool and two basketball courts.
senses.example_zh: 市府計畫興建一座運動綜合設施，內有游泳池和兩座籃球場。
senses.note: 名詞重音在第一音節

senses.en: a lasting worry or fear about something
senses.pattern: an inferiority complex / have a complex about / a guilt complex
senses.example: Teased about his height for years, Tim developed a [[complex]] about being short.
senses.example_zh: 多年來因身高被取笑，提姆對自己個子矮產生了情結。

senses.en: to be one of the causes of something
senses.pattern: contribute to / contribute to global warming / a contributing factor
senses.example: Doctors warn that too little sleep can [[contribute]] to weight gain and poor memory.
senses.example_zh: 醫師警告，睡眠不足可能是體重增加和記憶力變差的原因之一。
senses.note: 後接 to，to 為介系詞

senses.en: to write something for a newspaper, magazine, or book
senses.pattern: contribute an article to / contribute to a magazine / contribute a column
senses.example: My English teacher regularly [[contributes]] short stories to a magazine for young readers.
senses.example_zh: 我的英文老師定期向一本青少年雜誌投稿短篇小說。
senses.note: contributor 投稿人、撰稿人

gsat.sentence: Various factors have thus [[contributed]] to the phenomenon of smiling. As many psychologists now point out, this simple gesture is in fact far more complicated than it may appear.
The last factor [[contributing]] to the disappearance of coral reefs is people.

senses.en: strange or unusual
senses.pattern: a curious thing / a curious mixture of / it is curious that / curiously enough
senses.example: It is [[curious]] that the museum's oldest painting has no signature or date on it.
senses.example_zh: 奇怪的是，博物館裡最古老的那幅畫上既沒有簽名也沒有日期。
senses.note: 此義多修飾事物，而不是人

senses.en: the person in charge of an organization or department
senses.pattern: the director of the museum / a program director / the director of marketing / a medical director
senses.example: The [[director]] of the city library announced longer opening hours during the exam season.
senses.example_zh: 市立圖書館館長宣布，考試期間將延長開放時間。

senses.en: a member of the board that runs a company
senses.pattern: the board of directors / a managing director / a company director
senses.example: The board of [[directors]] voted to close two factories and move production overseas.
senses.example_zh: 董事會投票決定關閉兩座工廠，並將生產移往海外。
senses.note: board of directors 董事會

gsat.sentence: “They must remain here if the museum is to continue to achieve its aim, which is to show the world to the world,” said the [[director]] of the museum.

senses.en: a tax paid on goods bought or brought into a country
senses.pattern: customs duty / import duty / pay duty on / duty-free goods
senses.example: Travelers must pay [[duty]] on any cameras or phones worth more than the legal limit.
senses.example_zh: 旅客攜帶的相機或手機若價值超過法定限額，就必須繳納關稅。
senses.note: duty-free 免稅的

senses.en: one of the races or contests in a sports competition
senses.pattern: a track event / field events / the 100-meter event / compete in three events
senses.example: She won gold medals in two swimming [[events]] at last year's national games.
senses.example_zh: 她在去年全國運動會的兩個游泳比賽項目中奪得金牌。

senses.en: a particular way of doing something
senses.pattern: in a similar fashion / in an orderly fashion / in a timely fashion / in this fashion
senses.example: When the fire alarm rang, the students left the building in an orderly [[fashion]].
senses.example_zh: 火災警報響起時，學生們以井然有序的方式離開大樓。
senses.note: 常用 in a(n) + adj. + fashion

senses.en: to make or shape something, especially by hand
senses.pattern: fashion A from B / fashion A out of B / fashion A into B
senses.example: The villagers [[fashioned]] simple boats out of bamboo and old plastic bottles.
senses.example_zh: 村民用竹子和舊寶特瓶製作出簡易的小船。

senses.en: the bottom of the sea, a valley, or a forest
senses.pattern: the ocean floor / the sea floor / the forest floor / the valley floor
senses.example: Using a robot camera, scientists discovered strange glowing fish near the ocean [[floor]].
senses.example_zh: 科學家利用機器人攝影機，在接近海洋底部的地方發現了奇特的發光魚類。
senses.note: 另：take the floor（在會議中）發言

senses.zh: 使驚訝得說不出話；難倒
senses.en: to surprise or confuse someone completely
senses.pattern: be floored by / completely floor sb / floor sb with a question
senses.example: The interviewer's last question completely [[floored]] me, and I sat there in silence.
senses.example_zh: 面試官的最後一個問題讓我驚訝得說不出話，只能呆坐在那裡。
senses.note: 常用被動 be floored by

senses.en: wild animals or birds hunted for food or sport
senses.pattern: big game / game animals / a game reserve / hunt game
senses.example: Tourists once came here to hunt big [[game]], but now they shoot only with cameras.
senses.example_zh: 遊客從前來這裡獵捕大型獵物，如今只用相機拍攝。
senses.note: 此義不可數；big game 大型獵物

senses.en: willing to try something new, difficult, or risky
senses.pattern: be game for sth / be game to do sth / be game for anything
senses.example: I had never tried surfing before, but I was [[game]] to give it a go.
senses.example_zh: 我以前從沒衝過浪，但我很願意嘗試看看。
senses.note: 口語用法；常用 be game for / to V

senses.en: the point when something is at its strongest or busiest
senses.pattern: at the height of / the height of summer / at its height / the height of one's career
senses.example: At the [[height]] of the tourist season, the small island receives ten thousand visitors a day.
senses.example_zh: 在旅遊旺季的高峰，這座小島每天有一萬名遊客到訪。

senses.en: a high place or position
senses.pattern: a fear of heights / be afraid of heights / fall from a height
senses.example: My brother is so afraid of [[heights]] that he refuses to ride the Ferris wheel.
senses.example_zh: 我弟弟非常害怕高處，連摩天輪都不肯搭。
senses.note: 常用複數；reach new heights 再創高峰

gsat.sentence: In this line of work, the person is paid to do daring actions that are deemed too risky for the regular actor to perform, including jumping from [[heights]], crashing cars, or fighting with weapons.

senses.en: to influence or shape an idea, decision, or work
senses.pattern: inform a decision / inform policy / be informed by
senses.example: Her years of volunteering in a hospital clearly [[inform]] the way she writes about illness.
senses.example_zh: 她多年在醫院擔任志工的經歷，明顯影響了她書寫疾病的方式。
senses.note: informed (adj.) 有見識的、有根據的

senses.en: to give the police information about someone's wrongdoing
senses.pattern: inform on sb / inform against sb / inform on one's friends
senses.example: One gang member [[informed]] on the others, and the police arrested them all within days.
senses.example_zh: 一名幫派成員告發了其他人，警方幾天內就將他們全數逮捕。
senses.note: informer 告密者

senses.en: to stay in good condition or be enough for a time
senses.pattern: last long / last a lifetime / last sb a week / be built to last
senses.example: We packed only enough drinking water to [[last]] us three days on the mountain trail.
senses.example_zh: 我們帶的飲用水只夠我們在登山步道上用三天。
senses.note: last + 人 + 一段時間：夠某人用多久

senses.zh: 最不可能的；最不願意的
senses.en: least likely or least suitable
senses.pattern: the last person to do sth / the last thing I want / the last place I expected
senses.example: Shy and quiet, Amy is the [[last]] person you would expect to sing on stage.
senses.example_zh: 艾咪害羞又安靜，是你最不可能料到會上台唱歌的人。

gsat.sentence: Many might not even [[last]] that long!
Colored paint makes it sound better and [[last]] longer.

senses.en: to find the exact position of something or someone
senses.pattern: locate the source / locate a missing person / locate the problem / be unable to locate
senses.example: Rescue teams used drones to [[locate]] two hikers who had been missing since Sunday.
senses.example_zh: 搜救隊利用無人機，找出兩名自週日起失蹤的登山客的位置。
senses.note: 「位於」須用被動 be located in

gsat.sentence: They cannot [[locate]] the landmarks while trying to navigate forests.

senses.en: an action taken to deal with a problem
senses.pattern: take measures / safety measures / preventive measures / a temporary measure
senses.example: The school has taken new [[measures]] to keep students safe during typhoon season.
senses.example_zh: 學校已採取新措施，以確保學生在颱風季的安全。
senses.note: 此義常用複數 measures

senses.en: a way of judging or showing how good something is
senses.pattern: a measure of success / a reliable measure of / a measure of how
senses.example: Exam scores alone are not a fair [[measure]] of how much a student has learned.
senses.example_zh: 考試成績本身並不是評斷學生學了多少的公平衡量標準。

gsat.sentence: You can take some preventive [[measures]] to help avoid the discomfort.
Foggers, or bug bombs, should really be a [[measure]] of last resort.

senses.en: a widely believed idea that is not true
senses.pattern: a common myth / a popular myth / dispel a myth / the myth that
senses.example: It is a common [[myth]] that we use only ten percent of our brains.
senses.example_zh: 「人類只用了百分之十的大腦」是個常見的迷思。

senses.en: (of an idea) to come into someone's mind
senses.pattern: occur to sb / it occurred to me that / it never occurred to me
senses.example: It never [[occurred]] to me that my joke might hurt her feelings.
senses.example_zh: 我從沒想到我的玩笑可能會傷了她的心。
senses.note: 主詞是念頭：sth occurs to sb

senses.en: to exist or be found somewhere
senses.pattern: occur naturally / occur in nature / occur widely / occur in the wild
senses.example: This rare mineral [[occurs]] naturally in only a few volcanic regions of the world.
senses.example_zh: 這種稀有礦物只天然存在於世界上少數幾個火山地區。

gsat.sentence: One day, an idea [[occurred]] to Art Fry.
Such dimples tend to [[occur]] in families, and are assumed to be an inherited feature.

senses.en: a set of proposals or services offered together
senses.pattern: an aid package / a benefits package / a package of measures / a package tour
senses.example: The government announced a [[package]] of measures to help small shops survive the recession.
senses.example_zh: 政府宣布了一整套方案，協助小商店度過經濟衰退。
senses.note: package tour 套裝行程

senses.en: to present someone or something in an attractive way
senses.pattern: be packaged as / package A as B / cleverly packaged
senses.example: The old fishing village has been [[packaged]] as a romantic getaway for young couples.
senses.example_zh: 這座古老的漁村被包裝成年輕情侶的浪漫度假勝地。

gsat.sentence: This tour [[package]] is very appealing, and that one looks equally attractive. I don’t know which one to choose.

senses.en: to express something in particular words
senses.pattern: phrase a question / carefully phrased / phrase it differently / politely phrased
senses.example: She [[phrased]] her criticism so gently that nobody in the meeting felt offended.
senses.example_zh: 她把批評表達得非常委婉，會議上沒有人覺得被冒犯。

senses.en: to create a threat, problem, or danger
senses.pattern: pose a threat to / pose a risk / pose a challenge / pose a problem
senses.example: Plastic waste in the ocean [[poses]] a serious danger to sea turtles and seabirds.
senses.example_zh: 海洋中的塑膠垃圾對海龜和海鳥構成嚴重的危險。

senses.en: to pretend to be someone else to trick people
senses.pattern: pose as a police officer / pose as a customer / pose as a doctor
senses.example: The thief [[posed]] as a repairman to get inside the old couple's apartment.
senses.example_zh: 那名小偷假冒修理工人，混進了那對老夫婦的公寓。

senses.en: to ask a question that needs careful thought
senses.pattern: pose a question / pose a question to sb / the questions posed by
senses.example: At the end of her talk, the speaker [[posed]] a question that nobody could answer.
senses.example_zh: 演講結束時，講者提出了一個沒有人答得出來的問題。

gsat.sentence: Sometimes referred to as secret shoppers, mystery shoppers [[pose]] as regular customers to purchase items, eat in restaurants, make inquiries, or return items.
The organization believes that people may be motivated to buy elephant-friendly brands when they know more about the risk tea can [[pose]] to these endangered animals.

senses.en: someone or something that results from a process or situation
senses.pattern: a product of / the product of one's environment / a product of hard work / a product of its time
senses.example: Her calm confidence on stage is the [[product]] of years of daily practice.
senses.example_zh: 她在台上的沉著自信，是多年每日練習的產物。

senses.en: the number you get by multiplying numbers together
senses.pattern: the product of 4 and 6 / find the product / the product of two numbers
senses.example: The teacher asked us to find the [[product]] of the three numbers without a calculator.
senses.example_zh: 老師要我們不用計算機，求出那三個數的乘積。

senses.en: (of meat) cooked briefly so the inside is still red
senses.pattern: a rare steak / medium rare / cooked rare
senses.example: I asked for my steak well done, but the waiter brought one that was [[rare]].
senses.example_zh: 我點的牛排要全熟，服務生卻端來一份一分熟的。
senses.note: medium rare 三分熟；well done 全熟

senses.zh: 未經加工的；未經處理的
senses.en: in a natural state, not yet processed or analyzed
senses.pattern: raw materials / raw data / raw footage
senses.example: The scientists spent months turning the [[raw]] data from the survey into charts that the public could understand.
senses.example_zh: 科學家花了好幾個月，把問卷調查中未經處理的數據整理成大眾看得懂的圖表。
senses.note: raw materials＝原料

senses.en: (of skin) red and painful from rubbing or cold
senses.pattern: be rubbed raw / red and raw / raw skin
senses.example: After an hour of rowing without gloves, her hands were [[raw]] and too sore to hold a pen.
senses.example_zh: 沒戴手套划了一小時的船後，她的雙手破皮刺痛，痛得連筆都握不住。

senses.en: to be equal to or amount to something
senses.pattern: represent an increase of / represent a major change / represent a threat / represent a step forward
senses.example: Sales of electric scooters now [[represent]] nearly a third of the city's scooter market.
senses.example_zh: 電動機車的銷量目前相當於全市機車市場的近三分之一。

senses.en: to show or describe someone or something in a particular way
senses.pattern: represent sb as / be represented as / represent sth in a painting
senses.example: The novel [[represents]] the king as a lonely old man rather than a cruel ruler.
senses.example_zh: 這部小說把國王描繪成一位孤獨的老人，而不是殘暴的統治者。

gsat.sentence: Which of the following pictures best [[represents]] the image of a typical Maasai warrior?

senses.en: to try to do something
senses.pattern: seek to do sth / seek to improve / seek to reduce / seek to understand
senses.example: The new program [[seeks]] to reduce food waste in school cafeterias across the country.
senses.example_zh: 這項新計畫試圖減少全國學校餐廳的食物浪費。
senses.note: 後接 to V；過去式為 sought

senses.en: to ask someone for advice, help, or permission
senses.pattern: seek advice / seek help / seek permission / seek medical attention
senses.example: If the headaches continue for more than a week, you should [[seek]] medical advice.
senses.example_zh: 如果頭痛持續超過一週，你應該尋求醫師的建議。

gsat.sentence: Finally, when he was cruelly abused for not winning medals at the 2013 World Championships in Brazil, he decided to [[seek]] protection.
Recently, however, the International Olive Council (IOC) is [[seeking]] input on test methods to improve the transparency of the testing process and boost the accuracy of the results.

senses.en: to support one person or group in an argument
senses.pattern: side with sb / side against sb / side with the majority
senses.example: To my surprise, my parents [[sided]] with my little sister in our argument over the TV.
senses.example_zh: 出乎我意料的是，在我們為了電視爭吵時，爸媽竟然支持妹妹、站在她那邊。

senses.en: one of the people or groups in an argument or contest
senses.pattern: both sides / the other side / take sides / on sb's side
senses.example: Neither [[side]] was willing to give in, so the talks ended without an agreement.
senses.example_zh: 任何一方都不願讓步，談判因此在沒有共識的情況下結束。
senses.note: take sides 選邊站

gsat.sentence: In making a case for or against zoos, both [[sides]] argue that they’re saving animals.

senses.en: not strict or severe enough
senses.pattern: be soft on / go soft on / be too soft with / take a soft line
senses.example: Some parents complain that the school is too [[soft]] on students who bully others.
senses.example_zh: 有些家長抱怨學校對霸凌他人的學生太過寬容。
senses.note: have a soft spot for 特別喜愛

senses.en: not bright, loud, or harsh; pleasant and gentle
senses.pattern: soft light / soft music / a soft voice / soft colors
senses.example: The café uses [[soft]] lighting and quiet music to help customers relax after work.
senses.example_zh: 這家咖啡館用柔和的燈光和輕音樂，幫助顧客下班後放鬆。

senses.en: a building in which horses are kept
senses.pattern: a riding stable / in the stable / clean the stables
senses.example: Every morning before school, Lily feeds the horses and cleans the [[stable]].
senses.example_zh: 每天早上上學前，莉莉都會餵馬並打掃馬廄。

senses.en: to emphasize a fact, idea, or point
senses.pattern: stress the importance of / stress the need for / stress that / stress the point
senses.example: The coach [[stressed]] that teamwork matters more than any single player's talent.
senses.example_zh: 教練強調，團隊合作比任何一位球員的天分都重要。
senses.note: 名詞用法：put / lay stress on

senses.en: extra force used when saying a syllable or word
senses.pattern: the stress falls on / primary stress / put the stress on / word stress
senses.example: In the word “hotel,” the [[stress]] falls on the second syllable, not the first.
senses.example_zh: 在「hotel」這個字裡，重音落在第二音節，而不是第一音節。

senses.en: a small bird with pointed wings and a forked tail
senses.pattern: a flock of swallows / a swallow's nest / swallows return in spring
senses.example: Each spring, [[swallows]] return to build their nests under the roof of our old house.
senses.example_zh: 每年春天，燕子都會回到我們老家的屋簷下築巢。

senses.en: to hold back a feeling such as anger or pride
senses.pattern: swallow one's pride / swallow one's anger / swallow an insult
senses.example: Mark [[swallowed]] his anger and calmly explained the rule to the rude customer once more.
senses.example_zh: 馬克忍住怒氣，心平氣和地再向那位無禮的顧客解釋一次規定。
senses.note: swallow one's pride 放下自尊、拉下臉

senses.en: an official notice for breaking a traffic rule
senses.pattern: a parking ticket / a speeding ticket / get a ticket / give sb a ticket
senses.example: My uncle got a [[ticket]] for parking his car in front of a fire hydrant.
senses.example_zh: 我叔叔因為把車停在消防栓前面，被開了一張罰單。

senses.en: to give someone a notice for a traffic offense
senses.pattern: be ticketed for speeding / be ticketed for illegal parking / ticket a driver
senses.example: Drivers who use their phones at the wheel will be [[ticketed]] under the new law.
senses.example_zh: 依照新法，開車時使用手機的駕駛將被開罰單。
senses.note: 常用被動 be ticketed for

senses.en: to catch your foot on something and fall
senses.pattern: trip over / trip on / trip and fall / trip sb up
senses.example: Running down the dark hallway, I [[tripped]] over a schoolbag and hurt my knee.
senses.example_zh: 我在昏暗的走廊上奔跑時，被一個書包絆倒，傷了膝蓋。
senses.note: 過去式 tripped，重複字尾 p

senses.en: to set off an alarm or switch
senses.pattern: trip an alarm / trip a switch / trip the circuit breaker
senses.example: A cat walking across the yard [[tripped]] the alarm and woke the whole neighborhood.
senses.example_zh: 一隻貓走過院子時觸發了警報，把整個社區的人都吵醒。

senses.en: to go with someone on foot to a place
senses.pattern: walk sb home / walk sb to the station / walk sb to the door
senses.example: It was getting dark, so Kevin offered to [[walk]] his classmate to the bus stop.
senses.example_zh: 天色漸暗，所以凱文主動提議陪同學走到公車站。
senses.note: walk the dog 遛狗

senses.en: a person's job or position in society
senses.pattern: all walks of life / every walk of life / different walks of life
senses.example: The marathon attracted runners from all [[walks]] of life, including doctors, farmers, and students.
senses.example_zh: 這場馬拉松吸引了來自各行業、各階層的跑者，包括醫生、農夫和學生。
senses.note: 固定用法 from all walks of life

gsat.sentence: Jack’s clients are from all [[walks]] of life.

senses.en: a promise that you will do something
senses.pattern: keep one's word / give sb one's word / break one's word / a man of his word
senses.example: Dad gave us his [[word]] that he would be home in time for the school play.
senses.example_zh: 爸爸向我們保證，他一定會及時回家看學校的話劇表演。
senses.note: 此義只用單數

senses.en: a piece of news or a message
senses.pattern: send word / receive word / word came that / spread the word
senses.example: We waited all night, but no [[word]] came from the rescue team on the mountain.
senses.example_zh: 我們等了一整夜，山上的搜救隊卻始終沒有傳來任何消息。
senses.note: 不可數；動詞 word 指「措辭」

quiz.stem: In a ______ of fear and distrust, few workers dared to report the safety problems they had noticed at the factory.
quiz.explain_zh: climate＝風氣、氛圍。在恐懼與不信任的氛圍下，很少工人敢舉報安全問題。

quiz.stem: To find out how the shop cheated foreign visitors, the reporter ______ as a tourist and secretly recorded the whole conversation.
quiz.explain_zh: pose＝（pose as）假冒。記者假冒觀光客，查出商店如何欺騙外國遊客。

quiz.stem: Having lost most of its volunteers last year, the animal shelter ______ needs people to help feed the dogs and clean the cages.
quiz.explain_zh: badly＝非常、迫切地。收容所失去多數志工，迫切需要人手幫忙。

quiz.stem: Contrary to the popular ______ that goldfish forget everything within three seconds, experiments show that they can remember things for months.
quiz.explain_zh: myth＝迷思、錯誤觀念。金魚只有三秒記憶是迷思，實驗顯示牠們能記好幾個月。

quiz.stem: There was something ______ about the letter: it had no stamp or return address, and the handwriting changed halfway through.
quiz.explain_zh: curious＝奇怪的。那封信沒有郵票和寄件地址，筆跡還中途改變，很奇怪。

quiz.stem: Tina expected her best friend to support her idea, but he ______ with the teacher and said the plan was too risky.
quiz.explain_zh: side＝（side with）支持。好友沒有挺蒂娜，反而站在老師那邊。

quiz.stem: After several students were injured at the crossing, the city took strict ______ to slow down traffic near the school.
quiz.explain_zh: measure＝措施。學生在路口受傷後，市府採取嚴格措施減緩車速。

quiz.stem: Thanks to the GPS tracker on its collar, the family was able to ______ their lost dog within just a few hours.
quiz.explain_zh: locate＝找出…的位置。靠著項圈上的定位器，這家人幾小時內就找到走失的狗。

quiz.stem: At the ______ of the flu season, the hospital's emergency room was so crowded that some patients waited for hours in the hallway.
quiz.explain_zh: height＝頂點、高峰。流感季高峰時，急診室擠到病人得在走廊等。

quiz.stem: Critics say the judge was too ______ on the factory owner, who was fined only a small amount for polluting the river.
quiz.explain_zh: soft＝寬容的。法官只對污染河川的工廠老闆處以小額罰款，被批太寬容。
